title: next --batch picks slices whose files do not overlap
lead: With a configured `files_section`, `next --batch K --disjoint` returns up to K ready items whose named repo paths do not overlap, and `deps --overlap A B` shows the paths two items share.
findings_note: outer-session wishlist 2026-10-16, item 3: parallel pairs chosen by regex over Files sections
boundary: **Not in this slice:** a declared `files` field on items; checking the paths exist; the relay-brief generator, which may use the overlap later.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Running two slice relays at once needs slices whose files are disjoint, apart from the CHANGELOG. On 2026-10-16 the outer session chose s298+s307 and s308+s309 by pulling backticked paths out of each spec's Files section with a regex, then comparing them by eye. The section name is this project's own ("Files"), so slicer cannot hardcode it.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/config.py`:
  - `files_section`, the name of the section whose backticked repo paths count. It defaults to `""`, which turns the feature off.
  - `overlap_ignore`, a list of paths that never count as overlap, for example `["CHANGELOG.md"]`.
- A new module `src/slicer/paths.py` (pure, no I/O): extract the backticked paths from a section body. A path is a token with a `/` or a file extension. Drop any `:line` suffix.
- `src/slicer/ops.py` or the `next` selection code:
  - `--disjoint` takes the batch greedily in queue order, skipping any item whose paths meet an already-chosen item's.
  - An item with no paths is skipped under `--disjoint` and reported under `unknown_files`.
- `src/slicer/cli.py`:
  - `--disjoint` on `next`; it requires `--batch` and a configured `files_section`, else `usage`.
  - `deps --overlap A B [C…]` prints the shared paths per pair.
- `docs/configuration.md`, `docs/commands.md`, `docs/agents.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` under Added.
- `tests/test_paths.py`, `tests/test_next.py`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests and watch them go red.
2. `paths.py`, then the config keys, `next --disjoint` and `deps --overlap`.
3. Set `files_section` to `Files` and `overlap_ignore` to `["CHANGELOG.md"]` for this repo with `slicer config`. Run `next --batch 2 --disjoint` and paste the output into the note.
4. Docs and CHANGELOG; mutation-check (ignore the overlap; ignore `overlap_ignore`).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
